title: Common Vietnamese Dishes in Pregnancy: What to Keep, Tweak, or Skip
excerpt: A nutritionist's analysis of phở, bún, cơm tấm, trứng ốp la, and street snacks — safer prep, smart pairings, and what to leave out
content:
## Introduction to Pregnancy Nutrition
Pregnancy nutrition plays a crucial role in ensuring the health and well-being of both mother and baby. According to the [WHO](https://www.who.int/tools/elena/interventions/nutrition-counselling-pregnancy), nutrition during pregnancy should be prioritized to prevent health problems and ensure the optimal development of the fetus.

## Analysis of Common Vietnamese Dishes
Vietnamese dishes like phở, bún, cơm tấm, trứng ốp la, and street snacks are popular choices for many people. However, during pregnancy, it's essential to re-examine the preparation and ingredients of these dishes to ensure safety and nutrition.

* Phở: This traditional Vietnamese dish is made from noodles, broth, and various meats. According to the [CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/food-safety/people-at-risk/pregnant-women.html), it's crucial to ensure that the broth is cooked thoroughly to avoid the risk of food poisoning.
* Bún: Similar to phở, bún is another popular Vietnamese dish. It's essential to choose bún made from safe rice flour and avoid using raw or undercooked meats.
* Cơm tấm: This simple dish is rich in nutrition. Choose safe rice and avoid using raw or undercooked meats.
* Trứng ốp la: Eggs are an excellent source of protein, but it's crucial to ensure that they are cooked thoroughly to avoid the risk of food poisoning.
* Street snacks: Be cautious when choosing street snacks, as many may contain additives or be undercooked.

## Safe Preparation and Smart Pairings
To ensure safety and nutrition, it's essential to prepare these dishes carefully and pair them with other foods wisely.

* Cook thoroughly: Cook all meats and seafood thoroughly to avoid the risk of food poisoning.
* Choose safe ingredients: Select safe ingredients and avoid using raw or undercooked foods.
* Pair wisely: Combine foods to ensure a balanced diet.

## Dishes to Limit or Avoid
Some dishes should be limited or avoided during pregnancy, including:

* Raw or undercooked meats
* Raw or undercooked seafood
* Undercooked street snacks

## Conclusion
Pregnancy nutrition is critical for ensuring the health and well-being of both mother and baby. Prepare Vietnamese dishes carefully and pair them with other foods wisely to ensure safety and nutrition. For more information on [pregnancy meal planning](/blog/pregnancy-meal-planner), visit our website.

## Note
Before making any changes to your diet, consult with your doctor or a registered dietitian to ensure safety and effectiveness.
